verdicts.explanation: The abstract and Discussion give σ ≈ 0.18 mS cm−1 and Ea ≈ 0.40 eV for amorphous LiPO2F2 at 300 K as projected/calculated values from this paper's own MD, so origin is computational and the 300 K (26.85 °C) temperature is right. Secondary fields are null or not applicable, and none conflicts with the paper.

The Discussion attributes the ~10−9 S cm−1 and ~0.47 eV values for single-component SEI-like Li2O films to the cited work [5], so literature_cited is correct. No measurement temperature is given, so null is correct, and the secondary fields are null.
